requirements: Irregular walkable mountain-rock plateau separated from blocking cliff faces
Meandering travel paths narrow to one-cell bridge/boardwalk crossings and do not overwrite shore bands
Smoothed east coastline with one LPC family chain: grass/sand/wet-sand/ocean-shallow/ocean-deep
Freshwater pond with mud-bank, shallow-water, and deep-water contours from compatible LPC families
Compound transition masks use authored LPC quadrant composition instead of opaque square fills
One coherent dry tilled-soil field; watering is gameplay state rather than test noise
No generated ShoreFoam, RiverMouthBlend, ordinary-coast PebbleShore, or placeholder sample objects
Generated scene, metrics, and terrain acceptance fixtures validate before Rust compilation
diagnosticPolicy: The old rectangular QA-board layout is no longer the client default. Focused asset galleries remain editor diagnostics.
previewPolicy: Semantic topology previews are diagnostic colors only. LPC mapped previews must be generated from the production atlas; live-client screenshots remain final visual authority.
